questions.prompt: Which of these people led the Soviet Union?
questions.fact: Trotsky lost the power struggle after Lenin died and was murdered in exile in Mexico in 1940.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are marsupials?
questions.fact: Wombat droppings are cube-shaped, which stops them rolling off the rocks and logs they mark.

questions.prompt: In what year did the first Harry Potter film come out?
questions.fact: 2001. The last of the eight came out ten years later, in 2011.

questions.prompt: How long is a cricket pitch, in metres?
questions.fact: 22 yards, the length of an old surveyor's chain.

questions.prompt: Which country has the most time zones?
questions.fact: France has 12, counting its overseas territories. Russia has 11.

questions.prompt: Which spice is the most expensive by weight?
questions.hint: It is picked by hand from crocus flowers.
questions.fact: It takes around 150,000 crocus flowers, each picked by hand, to make one kilogram of saffron.
